name: Breadcrumb
summary: A trail of ancestor links ending in the current page, with the DS caret separator.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-breadcrumb> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; feed it an `items` JSON array — an entry with an `href` is a link, the last (or any href-less) entry is the current page. Links animate on hover via the shared motion tokens; the separator is the DS caret glyph via <aha-icon>, never a hand-rolled mark. Emits a composed `navigate` event.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `navigate`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: items
props.desc: The trail; an entry with href is a link, the last / href-less entry is the current page

props.name: navigate
props.desc: Composed event on a link click, detail { index, href }

whenToUse.when: showing where a page sits in a hierarchy the user can climb back up
switching between sibling views at the same level — not a hierarchy
a single linear step back is all that's needed

opinion.note: Keep breadcrumbs to the real ancestor path — don't pad them. The last item is the current page and is never a link. Labels are short nouns, sentence case.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Breadcrumb cell; spec derived from the token layer (text-secondary link, text-tertiary current, color-primary hover, icon-muted separator) + AntD Breadcrumb conventions (caret separator, current page not linked). Motion + separator glyph bound to the shared motion tokens and the DS icon library.
